ruling1_serviceCredential.attempted: Generate a credential in memory and set it on the existing non-admin identity via SYNO.Core.User set, POST body only.

blocker.provedNotPasswordSpecific: A no-op SYNO.Core.User set writing the account's EXISTING description back unchanged also returned 105. The session has read-only user management, not a password-specific restriction.
blocker.elevationAttempted: SYNO.Core.User.PasswordConfirm v2 succeeded and returned a valid SynoConfirmPWToken. The subsequent set STILL returned 105 with the token attached.
blocker.conclusion: The available admin credential cannot write user records. This is a hard DSM permission boundary.

ruling1_serviceCredential.notDone: No privilege was broadened. Group membership was not modified. No alternative escalation path was attempted.
operatorMustDoOneOf: Set a password for cg-context-ledger in DSM directly, then place it in Doppler cg-shared/prd as SYNOLOGY_SERVICE_USERNAME and SYNOLOGY_SERVICE_PASSWORD
Grant the automation credential user-management rights, which is a privilege broadening and therefore an operator decision
ruling1_serviceCredential.dopplerState: cg-shared/prd contains no SYNOLOGY_SERVICE_* names. Nothing was written, because no working credential was produced to write.

ruling2_shareProvisioning.reason: Ruling 2 permits only mutations NECESSARY to complete provisioning. Necessity is not yet established, and the evidence now suggests the share may need no change at all.

correctionToEarlierFinding.earlierClaim: FileStation cannot see the vault, so the declared production transport cannot reach it.
correctionToEarlierFinding.whyItWasWrong: That was measured as ADMIN. FileStation returns error 407 for Capital-Glass-AI-Evidence-meta as well, and meta is a healthy, enumerable share with configured snapshots and used quota. Both admin identities are deliberately is_writable=false on the vault.
correctionToEarlierFinding.consequence: The ADMIN measurement proves nothing about whether cg-context-ledger can reach the share. The decisive test is Ruling 4, executed AS the service account, which is blocked behind Ruling 1.
correctionToEarlierFinding.engineeringPosition: Mutating the share before that test could 'fix' something that was never broken, and would burn the in-place UUID preservation option for no reason.

ruling2_shareProvisioning.remainingGenuineAnomaly: The vault is absent from SYNO.Core.Share list under all 9 shareType values (all, dec, enc, local, usb, sdcard, cluster, shared_folder, volume) while meta is present. Unexplained. A competing hypothesis is that DSM excludes WORM subvolume shares from the standard list, which would mean the share is correctly configured and merely enumerated elsewhere. Not resolved either way.

appendOnly.writeFlag: wx -- an existing record can never be overwritten

ruling7_orphanRecovery.bindingProven: CURRENT OBJECT -> ciphertextHash (RECOMPUTED from bytes on disk) -> RECOVERY ASSOCIATION -> supersededLedgerEntryHash -> PRESERVED SUPERSEDED LEDGER ENTRY (file sha256 bound)
ruling7_orphanRecovery.independentVerification: 7/7 records verified end to end: object hash recomputed, preserved entry located and file-hashed, entry confirmed to reference the object, entryHash matched, keyVersion and plaintextHash confirmed COPIED rather than invented.
ruling7_orphanRecovery.historySynthesis: NONE. Each record is typed recordType=RECOVERY_ASSOCIATION with notAnOriginalLedgerEntry=true and representedAsCurrentLedgerEvent=false.
ruling7_orphanRecovery.multipleEntryHandling: Where several preserved entries reference one object, the EARLIEST is recovered and the others are recorded in additionalPreservedEntriesReferencingThisObject, so the choice is auditable rather than silent.

defectFoundAndFixed.defect: The first implementation folded recoveredAt into the record hash, so a re-run produced new filenames and appended duplicates -- 14 records for 7 objects.
defectFoundAndFixed.fix: Association identity is now derived only from (ciphertextHash, supersededLedgerEntryHash, supersededEntryFileSha256), with a pre-scan of existing records by ciphertextHash. Integrity hash still covers the whole record.
defectFoundAndFixed.cleanup: All 14 records from the defective run were removed and regenerated cleanly. They were this tool's own output, minutes old, fully re-derivable, and no source was touched.

ruling7_orphanRecovery.terminologyAdopted: These objects are no longer called orphans. Their data was never orphaned; the current-ledger association was missing. They are RECOVERED_LEDGER_ASSOCIATION.

populationModel.historicalFigurePreserved: 13,998 remains the population originally bound to the current ledger before recovery, and is not rewritten.

wormProofControlObject.reason: The canary stage is blocked behind the service credential. No canary was written, so no 90-day retention obligation was incurred.
wormProofControlObject.whenCreated: It will be classified WORM_PROOF_CONTROL_OBJECT in control/worm-proof/, excluded from the 13,998 / 7 / 14,005 accounting, with creationTimestamp, expectedRetentionPeriod, earliestExpectedDeletionDate, content hash, shareUuid and proofReceipt bound.
